paragraphs.text: Lady Laina was the leader of the Fyndhorn Elves during the Ice Age on Dominaria .
Laina was the leader of the Fyndhorn elvish council during the Ice Age .
Laina was the one who provided Freyalise with the Ice Cauldron for the World Spell . She was reluctant to allow Kaysa to participate.

Laina, Taaveti , the Fyndhorn Elves, Jaeuhl Carthalion , Kaysa, Jaya Ballard , and Knights of Kjeldor ventured into Yavimaya in search of a new home. They were attacked first by a Phyrexian War Beast and then by the forest itself, and Laina and Kaysa were taken captive by the Gorilla Chieftain . However, the elves and gorillas later allied in cleansing the Heart of Yavimaya .
